blocks.text: all, most, some, any, no / none — guruhning qancha qismi?

Bu so'zlar guruhning qancha qismi haqida gapirayotganimizni ko'rsatadi: hammasi (**all**), ko'pchiligi (**most**), ba'zilari (**some**), birortasi (**any**, savol va inkorda), hech biri (**no / none**). O'zbekchada buni ko'pincha qaratqich bilan aytamiz: odamlar**ning ko'pchiligi**, do'stlarim**ning ba'zilari**, ular**ning hech biri**. Inglizchada ikki xil qolip bor: umumiy fikr uchun — so'z + ot (**most people**), aniq guruh uchun — so'z + **of** + the / my / them (**most of the people** here).

rows: **most of the** people at the party
**none of the** shops in the village

blocks.text: Umumiy fikr: most people, some children

Umuman dunyodagi odamlar, narsalar haqida gapirganda **of** ham, **the** ham kerak emas: **Most** people ..., **Some** children ..., **All** plants ... O'zbekchada ham shunday: «**Ko'pchilik** odamlar», «**Ba'zi** bolalar». «Most of people» — xato, «the most people» ham xato (the most — orttirma daraja, 90-dars).

items.text: **Most** people in my town work in the factory.
**Some** students prefer to study at night.

blocks.text: Aniq guruh: most of the ..., some of my ...

Aniq bir guruh (shu sinf, mening do'stlarim, bu kitoblar) haqida gapirganda **of** + **the / my / these / those** ishlatiladi: **most of the** students in my class, **some of my** friends, **none of these** keys. O'zbekchada bu «-ning ko'pchiligi», «-ning ba'zilari» ga to'g'ri keladi. Sanalmaydigan ot bilan ham: **most of the** money (pulning ko'p qismi).

items.text: **Most of** the houses in this village are made of brick.
**Some of** my classmates have already found jobs.

blocks.text: Olmosh bilan: all of us, some of them

Olmosh bilan doim **of** + **us / you / them / it** (to'ldiruvchi shakli, 59-dars). «all us» yoki «most them» deyilmaydi. O'zbekchada bu ko'pincha egalik qo'shimchasi bilan bitta so'z bo'ladi: hamma**miz**, ko'pchili**gi**, birorta**ngiz**.

items.text: **All of us** were born in Fergana.
I made a big salad, but they only ate **some of it**.
items.translation: Katta salat tayyorladim, lekin ular uning **bir qismini** yeyishdi xolos.

blocks.text: **all** bilan **of** ni tushirib qoldirish mumkin: **all the** students = **all of the** students; **all my** money = **all of my** money. Lekin olmosh bilan **of** shart: **all of them** («all them» emas). **most, some, any, none** bilan esa the / my oldidan **of** doim kerak: **most of the** students («most the students» emas).

**none of** — «hech biri». O'zbekchada «Do'stlarim**ning hech biri** kel**ma**di» — ikki inkor; inglizchada bitta: **None of** my friends **came** (fe'l tasdiqda, 77–78-darslar). «None of my friends didn't come» — xato. **none of** + ko'plikdan keyin fe'l birlikda ham, ko'plikda ham bo'lishi mumkin; so'zlashuvda ko'pincha ko'plik: None of them **are** ready.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «Most of people like music.» → **Most people like music.**; «The most people ...» → **Most people ...**; «most the students» → **most of the students**; «all us» → **all of us**; «None of them didn't call.» → **None of them called.**; «Some of student» → **some of the students** (of dan keyin the / my va ko'plik).
Eslab qolish: **of** dan keyin doim aniq narsa keladi — **the**, **my**, **these** yoki **us / them**. Umumiy fikrda **of** yo'q: most people. Aniq guruhda **of** bor: most **of the** people here.
Bog'liq darslar: **some / any** → 76-dars, **no / none** → 77-dars, **every / all** → 80-dars, ikki narsa uchun **both of / neither of / either of** → 82-dars.

examples.title: General: **most** people, **some** birds
examples.description: Umumiy fikrda — of va the siz: **Most** people ... (odamlarning ko'pchiligi), **Some** birds ... (ba'zi qushlar), **All** students ... (barcha talabalar).

sentences.text: **Most** people in Uzbekistan drink tea every day.
sentences.translation: O'zbekistonda **ko'pchilik** har kuni choy ichadi.

sentences.text: **Some** birds can't fly.
sentences.translation: **Ba'zi** qushlar ucha olmaydi.

sentences.text: **All** students need a library card.
sentences.translation: **Barcha** talabalarga kutubxona kartasi kerak.

sentences.text: **Most** shops in the city are open until ten.
sentences.translation: Shahardagi do'konlarning **ko'pchiligi** soat o'ngacha ochiq.

sentences.text: In this part of London, **some** houses are very old.
sentences.translation: Londonning bu qismida **ba'zi** uylar juda eski.

sentences.text: I like **most** kinds of music, but not jazz.
sentences.translation: Musiqaning **ko'p** turlarini yoqtiraman, lekin jazni emas.

sentences.text: Dilnoza reads **most** books in English now.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza endi kitoblarning **ko'pini** inglizchada o'qiydi.

sentences.text: **Some** people prefer the mountains, and others prefer the sea.
sentences.translation: **Ba'zi** odamlar tog'ni, boshqalari esa dengizni afzal ko'radi.

sentences.text: Bekzod eats **most** vegetables, but he hates onions.
sentences.translation: Bekzod sabzavotlarning **ko'pini** yeydi, lekin piyozni yomon ko'radi.

sentences.text: In winter **most** roads in the mountains are closed.
sentences.translation: Qishda tog'lardagi yo'llarning **ko'pi** yopiq bo'ladi.

examples.title: **most of** / **some of** + the / my ...
examples.description: Aniq guruh haqida — **of** + the / my / these: **most of the** students in my class, **some of my** friends. «most of people» deyilmaydi.

sentences.text: **Most of** the students in my class live near the school.
sentences.translation: Sinfimizdagi o'quvchilarning **ko'pchiligi** maktab yaqinida yashaydi.

sentences.text: **Some of** my friends are studying abroad.
sentences.translation: Do'stlarimning **ba'zilari** chet elda o'qiyapti.

sentences.text: I've read **all of** the books on this shelf.
sentences.translation: Bu javondagi kitoblarning **hammasini** o'qiganman.

sentences.text: We spent **most of** the money on food.
sentences.translation: Pulning **ko'p qismini** ovqatga sarfladik.

sentences.text: **Some of** the photos from the wedding are really funny.
sentences.translation: To'ydagi suratlarning **ba'zilari** juda kulgili.

sentences.text: Madina was ill for **most of** the summer.
sentences.translation: Madina yozning **ko'p qismida** kasal bo'ldi.

sentences.text: Aziz knows **some of** the people at this party, but not all.
sentences.translation: Aziz bu ziyofatdagi odamlarning **ba'zilarini** taniydi, lekin hammasini emas.

sentences.text: **Most of** my colleagues come to work by bus.
sentences.translation: Hamkasblarimning **ko'pchiligi** ishga avtobusda keladi.

sentences.text: It rained for **some of** the time, but we still enjoyed our holiday in Scotland.
sentences.translation: Vaqtning **bir qismida** yomg'ir yog'di, lekin baribir Shotlandiyadagi ta'tilimiz yoqdi.

sentences.text: Sarah gave **most of** her old clothes to her little sister.
sentences.translation: Sara eski kiyimlarining **ko'pini** singlisiga berdi.

examples.title: With pronouns: **all of us**, **some of them**
examples.description: Olmosh bilan doim **of** + us / you / them / it: **all of us** (hammamiz), **most of them** (ularning ko'pchiligi), **some of it** (uning bir qismi). «all us» deyilmaydi.

sentences.text: **All of us** were tired after the long journey.
sentences.translation: Uzoq yo'ldan keyin **hammamiz** charchagan edik.

sentences.text: I bought ten postcards and sent **most of them** to my friends.
sentences.translation: O'nta otkritka sotib oldim va **ko'pini** do'stlarimga yubordim.

sentences.text: The cake was delicious, but we only ate **some of it**.
sentences.translation: Tort juda mazali edi, lekin uning **bir qismini** yedik xolos.

sentences.text: Do **any of you** speak French?
sentences.translation: **Birortangiz** frantsuzcha gapirasizmi?

sentences.text: My cousins visited us last week. **Most of them** live in Namangan.
sentences.translation: O'tgan hafta amakivachchalarim kelishdi. **Ko'pchiligi** Namanganda yashaydi.

sentences.text: Madina has hundreds of books, and she has read **all of them**.
sentences.translation: Madinaning yuzlab kitobi bor va u **hammasini** o'qigan.

sentences.text: Tom invited his classmates, but **some of them** couldn't come.
sentences.translation: Tom sinfdoshlarini taklif qildi, lekin **ba'zilari** kela olmadi.

sentences.text: I've got three sisters, and **all of them** are married.
sentences.translation: Uchta opam bor, **hammasi** turmushga chiqqan.

sentences.text: **Some of us** are going to the cinema tonight — do you want to come?
sentences.translation: **Ba'zilarimiz** bugun kechqurun kinoga boryapmiz — siz ham borasizmi?

sentences.text: The teacher gave us a long text, but **most of it** was easy to understand.
sentences.translation: O'qituvchi bizga uzun matn berdi, lekin uning **ko'p qismi** tushunarli edi.

examples.title: **none of** / **no** — one negative
examples.description: **none of** + the / my / them — «hech biri». O'zbekchada «**hech biri** kel**ma**di» — ikki inkor; inglizchada bitta: **None of them came**. Fe'l tasdiqda.

sentences.text: **None of** my friends came to the concert.
sentences.translation: Do'stlarimning **hech biri** konsertga **kelmadi**.

sentences.text: Sorry, **none of** these keys opens the front door.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, bu kalitlarning **hech biri** old eshikni **ochmaydi**.

sentences.text: We asked three people, but **none of them** knew the way.
sentences.translation: Uch kishidan so'radik, lekin ularning **hech biri** yo'lni **bilmasdi**.

sentences.text: **No** students were late today.
sentences.translation: Bugun **hech bir** talaba **kechikmadi**.

sentences.text: I tried on five jackets, but **none of them** fitted me.
sentences.translation: Beshta kurtka kiyib ko'rdim, lekin **hech biri** menga **to'g'ri kelmadi**.

sentences.text: Sarah made a cake, but **none of it** is left now.
sentences.translation: Sara tort pishirgan edi, lekin endi undan **hech narsa qolmadi**.

sentences.text: **None of us** wanted to go home — the party was great.
sentences.translation: **Hech birimiz** uyga **ketgimiz kelmasdi** — ziyofat zo'r edi.

sentences.text: The questions were difficult, and Bekzod answered **none of them**.
sentences.translation: Savollar qiyin edi, Bekzod ularning **hech biriga javob bermadi**.

sentences.text: Unfortunately, **none of** the hotels in the centre had free rooms.
sentences.translation: Afsuski, markazdagi mehmonxonalarning **hech birida** bo'sh xona **yo'q** edi.

sentences.text: **No** shops in the village sell newspapers any more.
sentences.translation: Qishloqdagi **hech bir** do'kon endi gazeta **sotmaydi**.

examples.title: **any of** — questions and negatives
examples.description: Savol va inkorda **any of** — «birortasi», «hech biri»: Did **any of** you see the match? I don't know **any of** them.

sentences.text: Did **any of** you see the match last night?
sentences.translation: Kecha kechqurungi o'yinni **birortangiz** ko'rdingizmi?

sentences.text: I don't know **any of** the people in this photo.
sentences.translation: Bu suratdagi odamlarning **hech birini tanimayman**.

sentences.text: Have **any of** your friends been to Samarkand?
sentences.translation: Do'stlaringizdan **birortasi** Samarqandda bo'lganmi?

sentences.text: Can **any of** you help me move a table?
sentences.translation: **Birortangiz** stolni surishga yordam bera olasizmi?

sentences.text: Madina didn't like **any of** the dresses in the shop.
sentences.translation: Madinaga do'kondagi ko'ylaklarning **hech biri yoqmadi**.

sentences.text: Do **any of** the children in your class speak English?
sentences.translation: Sinfingizdagi bolalardan **birortasi** inglizcha gapiradimi?

sentences.text: We didn't spend **any of** our savings on the trip.
sentences.translation: Sayohatga jamg'armamizdan **hech narsa sarflamadik**.

sentences.text: Was **any of** the information useful?
sentences.translation: Ma'lumotlardan **biror narsasi** foydali bo'ldimi?

sentences.text: Tom hasn't answered **any of** my messages this week.
sentences.translation: Tom bu hafta xabarlarimning **hech biriga javob bermadi**.

sentences.text: I've seen **some of** his films, but I haven't seen **any of** the new ones.
sentences.translation: Uning filmlarining **ba'zilarini** ko'rganman, lekin yangilarining **hech birini ko'rmaganman**.

examples.title: **Most people** or **most of the people**?
examples.description: Umumiy fikr — **most people** (umuman odamlarning ko'pchiligi); aniq guruh — **most of the people** (shu yerdagi odamlarning ko'pchiligi). Xuddi shunday: some children / some of the children.

sentences.text: **Most** people enjoy holidays by the sea.
sentences.translation: Odamlarning **ko'pchiligi** dengiz bo'yida dam olishni yaxshi ko'radi.

sentences.text: **Most of** the people at the wedding were from Bukhara.
sentences.translation: To'ydagi odamlarning **ko'pchiligi** Buxorodan edi.

sentences.text: **Some** children are afraid of the dark.
sentences.translation: **Ba'zi** bolalar qorong'idan qo'rqadi.

sentences.text: **Some of** the children in our street play football every evening.
sentences.translation: Ko'chamizdagi bolalarning **ba'zilari** har kuni kechqurun futbol o'ynaydi.

sentences.text: Not **all** dogs are friendly, so be careful.
sentences.translation: **Hamma** itlar ham do'stona emas, shuning uchun ehtiyot bo'ling.

sentences.text: **All** the dogs in our village know my grandfather.
sentences.translation: Qishlog'imizdagi **hamma** itlar bobomni taniydi.

sentences.text: Emma loves **most** fruit, but she doesn't eat bananas.
sentences.translation: Emma mevalarning **ko'pini** yaxshi ko'radi, lekin banan yemaydi.

sentences.text: Aziz ate **most of** the fruit in the bowl.
sentences.translation: Aziz idishdagi mevaning **ko'pini** yeb qo'ydi.

sentences.text: In Britain **most** shops close early on Sundays.
sentences.translation: Britaniyada do'konlarning **ko'pchiligi** yakshanba kunlari erta yopiladi.

sentences.text: **Most of** the shops near my flat are open on Sundays, luckily.
sentences.translation: Baxtimga, kvartiram yaqinidagi do'konlarning **ko'pchiligi** yakshanba kunlari ham ochiq.

examples.title: Exam results: **Most of them** passed
examples.description: Ota-ona va o'qituvchi suhbati: **all of, most of, some of, any of, none of** va umumiy **most** students.

sentences.text: — How did the class do in the English exam? Did **all of** the students pass?
sentences.translation: — Sinf ingliz tili imtihonini qanday topshirdi? **Barcha** o'quvchilar o'tdimi?

sentences.text: — Not quite. **Most of** them passed, but three failed.
sentences.translation: — Unchalik emas. **Ko'pchiligi** o'tdi, lekin uchtasi yiqildi.

sentences.text: — Oh dear. Were **any of** the questions very difficult?
sentences.translation: — Voy. Savollardan **birortasi** juda qiyinmidi?

sentences.text: — Yes, **some of** them were quite hard — especially the listening.
sentences.translation: — Ha, **ba'zilari** ancha qiyin edi — ayniqsa tinglash qismi.

sentences.text: — And did **any of** the students get full marks?
sentences.translation: — **Birorta** o'quvchi to'liq ball oldimi?

sentences.text: — Yes, Madina and Bekzod. **None of** their answers were wrong!
sentences.translation: — Ha, Madina va Bekzod. Ularning **hech bir** javobi **xato emas** edi!

sentences.text: — Wonderful! Did my son Aziz answer **all of** the questions?
sentences.translation: — Ajoyib! O'g'lim Aziz savollarning **hammasiga** javob berdimi?

sentences.text: — He answered **most of** them, but he didn't finish the writing part.
sentences.translation: — U **ko'pchiligiga** javob berdi, lekin yozma qismini tugatmadi.

sentences.text: — I see. Does he need **some** extra lessons?
sentences.translation: — Tushunarli. Unga **biroz** qo'shimcha dars kerakmi?

sentences.text: — Not really. **Most** students make the same mistake at first.
sentences.translation: — Shart emas. Boshida **ko'pchilik** o'quvchilar xuddi shu xatoni qiladi.

examples.title: Mixed practice: **all**, **most**, **some**, **any**, **none**
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: umumiy fikrda so'z + ot, aniq guruhda **of the / my**, olmosh bilan **of them / of us**, **none of** bilan bitta inkor.

sentences.text: **All of** my family came to my graduation.
sentences.translation: Bitiruv kechamga **butun** oilam keldi.

sentences.text: **Most** teenagers spend hours on their phones.
sentences.translation: O'smirlarning **ko'pchiligi** telefonida soatlab vaqt o'tkazadi.

sentences.text: **Some of** the apples were bad, so I threw them away.
sentences.translation: Olmalarning **ba'zilari** chirigan ekan, shuning uchun ularni tashlab yubordim.

sentences.text: **None of** the buses go to the airport after midnight.
sentences.translation: Yarim tundan keyin avtobuslarning **hech biri** aeroportga **bormaydi**.

sentences.text: Can I see **some of** your photos from Bukhara?
sentences.translation: Buxorodagi suratlaringizning **ba'zilarini** ko'rsam bo'ladimi?

sentences.text: James spends **most of** his free time in the garden.
sentences.translation: Jeyms bo'sh vaqtining **ko'p qismini** bog'da o'tkazadi.

sentences.text: I asked my classmates for help, but **none of them** had time.
sentences.translation: Sinfdoshlarimdan yordam so'radim, lekin **hech birining** vaqti **yo'q** edi.

sentences.text: **No** child in our school goes home alone.
sentences.translation: Maktabimizda **hech bir** bola uyga yolg'iz **ketmaydi**.

sentences.text: We didn't understand **any of** the signs at the station in Tokyo.
sentences.translation: Tokiodagi vokzalda belgilarning **hech birini tushunmadik**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza sold **some of** her old furniture and gave the rest to her neighbours.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza eski mebellarining **bir qismini** sotdi, qolganini esa qo'shnilariga berdi.
